question.question: In triangle ABC, if angle A = 87°, side AB = 22 cm, and angle B = 52°, find the length of side BC using the sine formula. Show your steps.
question.referenceAnswer: Using the sine formula, \(\frac{BC}{\sin 41^\circ} = \frac{22}{\sin 52^\circ}\). Solving gives \(BC = \frac{22 \sin 41^\circ}{\sin 52^\circ} \approx 18.3\) cm (to 3 significant figures).
question.evidence: By the sine formula, \(\dfrac{BC}{\sin 41^\circ} = \dfrac{22 \text{ cm}}{\sin 52^\circ}\) \(\Rightarrow BC = \dfrac{22 \sin 41^\circ}{\sin 52^\circ} \text{ cm}\) \(= \underline{18.3} \text{ cm, cor. to 3 sig. fig.}\)
